b1-unit-44.44.1 Gap Year Diaries: thank you!:
Danny: Welcome back to Gap Year Diaries! Today's episode is a thank-you episode. This year a lot of people helped me, and I want to thank five of them.
Danny: Number one: Mrs. Lima, the owner of my hostel. When an ATM kept my debit card, I wasn't able to get any money for more than a week. Mrs. Lima lent me some cash, and she didn't let me pay her back until my new card arrived.
Danny: Number two: Tomás, in Patagonia. After a long walk on my fourth day, I knocked on his door. I was exhausted, and I couldn't find anywhere to stay nearby. Tomás put me up for two nights, and he didn't want anything for it.
Danny: Number three: my friend Ana. Before my job interview, I was so nervous that I couldn't sleep. Ana gave me some great advice. Actually, she planned my whole week! And I managed to get the job.
Danny: Number four: Bruno. He gave me a ride to my first day at work. He drove very carefully... well, almost.
Danny: And number five: a stranger. Last Sunday, I bought a bookcase for my room, and I wasn't able to carry it home by myself. It was too heavy. A man stopped and asked, "Do you need a hand?" Together, we managed to carry it all the way to the hostel and up three floors. Then he just smiled and left. I didn't even ask his name! So, if you're listening... thank you!
Danny: When I was a kid, I could do everything by myself. Or that's what I thought! This year I learned to say yes when people offer help. And one day, I hope I'll be able to help someone like them.
Danny: Now a question for you. Who helped you this year? Were you able to say thank you? Send me a message!
